rounds.text: Envirotech Systems Ltd is trading at a heavily discounted valuation of 8.36x P/E [E1], sitting just 1% of the way up its 52-week range [E5] despite delivering exceptional fundamental performance. The company boasts outstanding profitability metrics, featuring a robust ROCE of 22.82% and an ROE of 17.31%, both comfortably outpacing sector benchmarks of 13.13% and 11.11% respectively [E10, E9]. This superior capital allocation is paired with strong multi-year compounding, demonstrated by a 5-year compounded sales growth of 43% and an extraordinary 5-year profit growth of 77% [E14, E17]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow model suggests a massive intrinsic value compared to the current market price, leaving an expansive margin of safety of 79.3% where today's price absurdly implies negative earnings growth [E38, E39, E40]. Insider conviction reinforces this undervaluation, with promoters increasing their holding to 69.78% [E34].
